name: Takaro Official Registry
description: Modules made and reviewed by the Takaro team.

modules.name: afk-kick
modules.description: AFK Kick — periodically checks player positions and warns/kicks idle players. A permission exempts specific players from AFK detection.

modules.name: bank
modules.description: A savings bank: players deposit and withdraw currency to a separate bank balance that earns daily interest (rate, cap, minimum balance, VIP rate via permission count). Optional withdraw fee and balance cap. Admin bankstats shows total held and top savers.

modules.name: bounties
modules.description: Player bounties for PvP servers: `bounty <player> <amount>` holds currency on a target, the player who kills the target collects the pot. List, cancel (minus a fee), exclusion groups, no self-claims and automatic refunds when a bounty expires. Needs the game to report the killer (player-death attacker, or a log line such as 7 Days to Die's `killed by`).

modules.name: chat-faq-bot
modules.description: Answers common player questions in chat automatically. Match FAQ entries by keywords (any/all words) or regex, reply privately or publicly, with server and per-player cooldowns so it never spams. Placeholders {player} {prefix} {currency} plus your own. Players type faq to see topics; admins use faqlist and faqtest.

modules.name: chatBridge
modules.description: Connect chat to other services like Discord.

modules.name: clans
modules.description: Clans: players form groups with a name and tag. Create a clan (optional currency cost), invite online players, join by invite, leave, and let leaders/officers kick members. Clan chat sends a private message to every online member. Optional shared clan bank (deposit; leader withdraws). Leaderboard ranks clans by total member playtime. All data lives in Takaro variables. Works on every game that supports private messages.

modules.name: community-fund
modules.description: Community Fund — players contribute currency toward a shared goal. When the threshold is reached the fund resets and completion commands fire.

modules.name: daily-quests
modules.description: Daily quests: every day each player gets a few random quests from a pool you configure, like kill 30 enemies, play 60 minutes, send 10 chat messages, buy something in the shop, earn currency or use a command (claim daily, vote). Progress is tracked from game events, players get a PM at milestones and are paid currency and/or items on completion. Players see their quests with /quests and can swap one with /questreroll for a fee. Quest types your game doesn't emit can be switched off.

modules.name: dailyRewards
modules.description: Provides daily login rewards with streak tracking

modules.name: discord-status-bridge-7d2d
modules.description: 7 Days to Die Discord bridge with chat relay, localized monitoring events, blood moon notices, and a persistent customizable server status message.

modules.name: economyUtils
modules.description: A set of commands to allow players to manage their currency.

modules.name: geoBlock
modules.description: Block players from certain countries from joining the server.

modules.name: gimme
modules.description: Randomly selects item from a list of items and entities. Fixed issue with item identifiers.

modules.name: happy-hour
modules.description: Timed boost events to fill your server: schedule them with cron (default Friday 20:00-22:00 UTC) or start one with happyhour start <minutes> [multiplier]. During the event players get bonus currency on kills and playtime, optional bonus item drops, and start/reminder/end broadcasts. happyhour shows the status. Optional Discord announcements.

modules.name: highPingKicker
modules.description: Automatically kick players with high ping, with warnings and configurable thresholds.

modules.name: ip-watch
modules.description: IP Watch: an anti-cheat helper. When a player joins from a new IP, it checks if that IP is shared with other players (possible alt or shared account), if the country changed, and optionally if the IP is a VPN or proxy. By default it only alerts admins in game (IP_WATCH_ALERTS) and optionally in a Discord channel; each rule can also kick or ban. Admins can run ipcheck <player>. Raw IPs are masked by default.

modules.name: jail
modules.description: Staff jail: save a jail spot, jail a player for N minutes with a reason, keep them inside a radius (checked every minute), auto-release them back to where they were or to a release point. Optional Jailed role while in jail. Commands: setjail, jail, unjail, jailed, jailtime. Works on any game that supports teleporting players.

modules.name: kill-tracker
modules.description: Kill/Death Tracker — tracks player kills, deaths, and points with streaks, leaderboards, and seasonal resets.

modules.name: lottery
modules.description: Players can buy tickets for a lottery, and the winner is chosen at random.

modules.name: mini-games
modules.description: Unified mini-games module with daily puzzles (Wordle, Hangman, Hot/Cold) and live chat rounds (Trivia, Scramble, Math race, Reaction race). Skill-based, point-scoring, optional currency rewards, boost tiers, cross-game leaderboards. Trivia rounds fetch questions from the public Open Trivia Database (https://opentdb.com) when `triviaQuestionSource` is `api` (the default), so the module makes outbound HTTPS requests to opentdb.com from Takaro; on failure it falls back to the custom bank.

modules.name: player-reports
modules.description: Players report griefers, cheaters or problems with one command. Each report becomes a numbered ticket with positions and recent chat attached. Online staff get a PM, an optional Discord alert fires, and staff list, view and close tickets in game. The reporter is told when their report is handled. Cooldown and an open-report limit stop spam.

modules.name: playerOnboarding
modules.description: Collection of functions that are executed when a player joins the server. Helps with onboarding new players, like sending a welcome message. The starter kit is an Item Set, managed on the server's Item Sets page.

modules.name: playtime-buff-rewards
modules.description: Hourly playtime rewards with configurable currency, command, and buff rewards.

modules.name: private-messages
modules.description: Private messages for players: msg and reply to online players, leave mail for offline players (delivered when they join), check when someone was last seen, and ignore players who bother you. Anti-spam cooldown and optional, off-by-default staff social spy.

modules.name: random-teleport
modules.description: Random Teleport (/rtp): teleport to a random spot inside a ring around a centre point or a rectangle. Blocked zones (trader areas, spawn) are skipped. Optional cooldown (VIPs can skip it) and currency cost, charged only after a successful teleport. Configurable height: 7 Days to Die and DayZ place the player on the ground, other games use the configured Y. Warmup via the command delay setting. Needs a game that supports teleporting players.

modules.name: referral-program
modules.description: Players invite others via a referral code; referrers earn currency or items when their referees hit a playtime threshold, with daily/lifetime caps and VIP tiering.

modules.name: reserved-slots
modules.description: Reserved slots for supporters and staff. Keep the last few slots free: when a supporter joins a full server, the newest (or lowest-playtime, or a random) regular player is kicked with a friendly message. Regular players who join into the reserved zone can be turned away. Staff can be exempt. Admin command shows current slot usage. Games without kick support fail gracefully.

modules.name: server-toolkit
modules.description: Cross-game utility commands for server info, rules, moderation, and simple economy administration.

modules.name: serverMessages
modules.description: Send automated, rotated, configurable messages to players on the server.

modules.name: shopActions
modules.description: Built-in shop actions for common use cases like granting roles, sending messages, giving an Item Set, and executing commands. The give-item action gives an Item Set, managed on the server's Item Sets page. Upgrading from 0.0.1 unlinks every shop listing that uses one of these actions; re-link each listing to this version's action afterwards.

modules.name: teleport-requests
modules.description: Teleport Requests (/tpa): ask to teleport to an online player (tpa) or ask them to come to you (tpahere). They answer with tpaccept or tpdeny. Requests expire, one open request per player (tpcancel). Optional cooldown, currency cost (charged only after a successful teleport) and height offset. Players can block others with tpblock. Needs a game that supports teleporting players.

modules.name: teleports
modules.description: A set of commands to allow players to set their own teleport points and teleport to them.

modules.name: timedShutdown
modules.description: Automatically shut down the server at a specific time.

modules.name: utils
modules.description: A collection of useful commands

modules.name: vote-restart
modules.description: Vote Restart — players vote democratically to restart the server. Dynamic threshold based on online non-immune players.

modules.name: voteRewards
modules.description: Rewards players who vote for this game server on the Takaro Server List. List the server publicly on its Public page first. Only verified votes are rewarded: the voter signed in with a Takaro account linked to their player, or with a linked Steam account. In-game items and commands for an offline player wait until they next join, or until they run the claimvote command.

modules.name: warn-system
modules.description: Warn System — staff warn players with a reason; warnings are stored with date and staff name, expire after a set number of days, and escalate automatically (by default 3 warnings = kick, 5 = 24-hour ban, 7 = permanent ban). Players can check their own warnings, staff can check and remove anyone's. Optional public broadcast and Discord log.

modules.name: weekly-top-rewards
modules.description: Weekly Top Rewards ranks players every week on playtime, kills and currency earned. A cron job pays the top 3 per category (currency, optional items, optional expiring role), broadcasts the winners and can post them to Discord, including a live Discord leaderboard that keeps updating. Players check live standings with /weeklytop.

modules.name: welcome-back
modules.description: One-time welcome-back reward (currency + optional items, scaled by days away) and a PM when a player returns after being away. Once per absence, skips brand-new players, VIP multiplier via permission count, and a weekly 'players returned' stats command for admins.

modules.name: wipes
modules.description: Tells players about server wipes: a /wipe command with the last and next wipe, reminders before a scheduled wipe, and an announcement when the server is wiped.

modules.name: zombie-racing
modules.description: Zombie Racing lets players bet on a configurable virtual race, locks betting when a race starts, broadcasts live race commentary while the race is running, then finishes the race through delayed hooks after the configured duration.
